name: Polymer Uncertainty Quantification Benchmark
description: Compares uncertainty quantification methods for machine learning models predicting polymer properties to assess calibration and predictive uncertainty.
evaluation_method: probabilistic/regression metrics such as negative log-likelihood (NLL), CRPS, RMSE and calibration measures (e.g., expected calibration error for regression)
general_score_metric: negative log-likelihood (NLL) / CRPS (primary metrics for reported UQ performance)
reputation: A recent, domain-specific benchmark for polymer property uncertainty quantification with limited adoption so far (new preprint release).
notes: Specialized materials-science benchmark (non-LLM) requiring predictive distributions rather than point estimates; results sensitive to metric choice and experimental noise in property measurements; reproducibility depends on access to the same property measurement protocols and featurizations.
